company.shortDescription: Codyco is an artificial intelligence company offering AI-based phone assistance for hotel reservations and reduces missed bookings.
company.description:
€5,000 more in bookings. In 4 weeks. For one 53-room hotel.

Your phone rings. You miss the call. You lose a booking.

We get those bookings back for you.

Here is how it works:

- You send your missed calls to us.
- Our AI answers and takes the booking.
- The booking goes right into your PMS.

Even with a call center or central reservation department, you miss 5% of calls. For a group your size, that’s a seven-figure leak.

We already help 7 hotel groups just like yours. They run over 350 hotels. 

We connect to your PMS. Opera, Sihot, Apaleo and more.

Setup takes your team less then two days of work. 
And your staff needs zero training.
